status: NEW (surfaced by the v4 reader-interface definition that R3-FIND-004 demanded)
description: v4 resolved R3-FIND-004 by defining the reader interface (behavioral-spec.md:22-28), but the net_worth_usd computation it now wires to that interface is dimensionally under-specified and not implementable as written. R3 defines net_worth_usd = usdc(id)+native(id) (USD) (behavioral-spec.md:47-48). The reader exposes nativeBalanceWei(addr) -> bigint (ETH WEI, 18-decimals) and usdcBalanceAtomic(addr) -> bigint (USDC atomic, 6-decimals) (behavioral-spec.md:24-25). Neither is a USD figure: (1) there is NO ETH/USD price source anywhere in the reader interface or the spec, so native ETH cannot be converted to USD at all; (2) the decimal scaling between wei (1e18), USDC atomic (1e6), and a USD float is never specified. 'usdc+native' literally sums a 1e6-scaled bigint and a 1e18-scaled wei bigint and calls the result USD, which is arithmetically meaningless. Because net_worth_usd is the R2 tie-breaker for ranking (behavioral-spec.md:41) and a displayed headline (R4/R6), this ambiguity makes both the RED unit tests (what value should the mock return / what does enrichOnChain compute?) and the ranking non-deterministic.

evidence.snippet: net_worth_usd = usdc(id)+native(id) (USD). Inflows from the agent's own id / OUR_INSTANCE_IDS / SEED_ADDRESSES are excluded

crossEvidence.note: reader returns nativeBalanceWei (ETH wei, 18-dec) and usdcBalanceAtomic (6-dec) — no USD, no ETH/USD price method

fix: Either (a) add an ETH/USD price method to the reader (e.g. ethUsdPrice() -> number, with a defined source + failure->unverified) and specify the exact conversion net_worth_usd = usdcAtomic/1e6 + (nativeWei/1e18)*ethUsd, or (b) scope net_worth to USDC-only for this slice and drop native from the USD sum. Specify the decimal scaling explicitly so the mock and the ranking are deterministic.
